title: Pick-rate decline versus SKU slotting
prompt: Warehouse pick rate fell 18% after new handheld scanners were introduced. Determine why.
facts: Pick rate began falling four days before scanner rollout.
Scanner error rate is below 0.5% and unchanged by shift.
A slotting reset moved fast-moving SKUs farther from packing stations one week before the decline.
Two zones not affected by the slotting reset received the same scanners and maintained pick rate.
